paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.86 as of 2026-07-29, representing a decrease of 6.69% from the prior close and 36.03% over the last 21 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Recent news includes a headline from Stocktwits regarding the company's stock tumbling more than 28% in after-hours trading, which mentions the departure of CEO Toby Neugebauer as of April 17, 2026, and the establishment of an Interim Office of the CEO.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing and four new social posts in the last 24 hours.
